raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

#62564 moved the 4-GPU L4 PD-disagg accuracy steps to nightly-only, leaving PRs without NVIDIA-side PD accuracy coverage (the AMD mirrors still run on PRs per #62567). This adds one automatic 2-GPU L4 step that keeps a core set of NIXL PD paths and architectures running on every PR, with prefill and decode sharing GPUs where needed to stay within the 2-GPU budget.

Not a duplicate of #62568, which shards the nightly-only 4-GPU sweeps themselves; this PR restores per-PR coverage at a smaller scale.

## Claims

- A single new automatic step, `(L4) NixlConnector PD accuracy core` (`nixlconnector-pd-accuracy-core-2-gpus`), runs 10 configurations on a 2-GPU L4 pod (~2.5-2.7 GPU-h per PR) covering every model family in the NIXL PD suite that fits a 24 GB L4:

| # | Config | Model | Path / architecture covered | P / D GPUs | Util |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | TP1/TP1 | Qwen3-0.6B | Dense GQA baseline, pull connector | 0 / 1 dedicated | 0.6 |
| 2 | P-TP1 / D-TP2 | Qwen3-0.6B | Hetero-TP, decoder TP>1 | 0 / 1,0 shared | 0.35 |
| 3 | P-TP2 / D-TP1 | Qwen3-0.6B | Hetero-TP, prefiller TP>1 | 0,1 / 0 shared | 0.35 |
| 4 | DP-EP (P-TP1, D-DP2) | deepseek-vl2-tiny | MoE expert parallel + DP-attention decode | 0 / 1,0 shared | 0.4 |
| 5 | Push PP2xTP1 | Qwen3-0.6B | NixlPushConnector, PP prefill layer slicing | 0,1 / 0,1 shared | 0.35 |
| 6 | SLEEP_WAKE TP1/TP1 | Qwen3-0.6B | Sleep/wake round-trip before serving | 0 / 1 dedicated | 0.6 |
| 7 | TP1/TP1 | deepseek-vl2-tiny | MLA KV transfer | 0 / 1 dedicated | 0.8 |
| 8 | TP1/TP1 | granite-4.0-h-tiny | Hybrid SSM Mamba2 conv state (+ small MoE) | 0 / 1 dedicated | 0.8 |
| 9 | TP1/TP1 | Qwen3.5-0.8B | Hybrid SSM GDN conv state | 0 / 1 dedicated | 0.8 |
| 10 | TP1/TP1 | gemma-4-E2B-it | Sliding-window attention + model-native cross-layer KV sharing (`num_kv_shared_layers: 20`) | 0 / 1 dedicated | 0.8 |

- The gemma config was previously unreachable: no CI step ever set `SW_ATTN`, so gemma PD accuracy had no coverage anywhere, including nightly. Sleep/wake previously ran nightly only (inside the 4-GPU step).
- `run_accuracy_test.sh` is unchanged; all engine launch logic is reused. The new sweep script follows the existing `config_sweep_*` pattern.

## Validation

No GPUs were available locally, so validation was static plus the `/ci run` below:

- `pre-commit` hooks pass on the commit (shellcheck with the repo rcfile, Buildkite key check, test tethering).
- Stubbed dry-run of the sweep script executes all 10 configs with the intended env and args (verified by capturing the `run_accuracy_test.sh` invocations).
- GPU-assignment math from `run_accuracy_test.sh` simulated for a 2-GPU pod: shared configs peak at 0.7-0.8 memory fraction per GPU (two engines), dedicated configs at 0.6-0.8. DeepSeek-VL2-Tiny is ~6.5 GB bf16 (3B total / 1B activated), fitting two engines on one 24 GB L4 at 0.4.
- `google/gemma-4-E2B-it` HF config verified to declare `num_kv_shared_layers: 20`, and vLLM consumes that key natively (`add_kv_sharing_layers_to_kv_cache_groups`), so config 10 exercises cross-layer KV sharing without any extra flag.
- First `/ci run nixlconnector-pd-accuracy-core-2-gpus` is the real gate: configs 2-5 (P/D GPU co-location) and 10 (first-ever execution of the gemma PD config) have never run on hardware.

## Details

- Sharing mechanics: `run_accuracy_test.sh` spreads engines modulo the visible GPUs, so on a 2-GPU pod every TP>1 config co-locates prefill and decode ranks. Shared configs cap `--gpu-memory-utilization` at 0.35 (0.4 for vl2-tiny) so two engines fit side by side on 24 GB L4s; Qwen3-0.6B is ~1.2 GB bf16 per TP1 engine.
- Left in the nightly-only 4-GPU sweeps: TP2/TP2, FlashInfer, Mamba1, the wider cross-layer and SW sweeps, MoE DP-EP variants at higher util. Cross-layer layout keeps per-PR coverage via the existing 2-GPU MultiConnector step (normal + BLHNC).
- No AMD mirror on the new step: the MI300/MI355 mirrors of the nightly-only steps are `optional: false` (#62567) and already cover these paths on PRs.
- Known gap left out of scope: the NHD decoder layout (`enable_permute_local_kv`) is not wired to any CI step, nightly included. Worth a separate PR if that path matters.
- Follow-up option: once #62568 lands, this step could enroll in `automatic_shard` to cut wall time across jobs at the same GPU-hour cost.

---

files.patch:
@@ -205,6 +205,28 @@ steps:
         - uv pip install --system -r /vllm-workspace/requirements/kv_connectors_rocm.txt
         - HYBRID_SSM=1 ATTENTION_BACKEND=TRITON_ATTN bash v1/kv_connector/nixl_integration/config_sweep_accuracy_test.sh
 
+# Per-PR core of the nightly-only 4-GPU sweeps above: hetero-TP (both
+# directions), MoE DP-EP decode, push-mode PP prefill, sleep/wake, MLA,
+# hybrid SSM (Mamba2, GDN), and sliding-window attention with cross-layer
+# KV sharing on a 2-GPU pod. TP>1 configs share GPUs between prefill and
+# decode (gpu-memory-utilization 0.35 per engine); TP1/TP1 architecture
+# configs keep one dedicated GPU per side.
+- label: ":nvidia: (L4) NixlConnector PD accuracy core"
+  key: nixlconnector-pd-accuracy-core-2-gpus
+  timeout_in_minutes: 90
+  working_dir: "/vllm-workspace/tests"
+  device: l4
+  num_devices: 2
+  # No AMD mirror: the MI300/MI355 mirrors above are optional: false and
+  # already cover these paths on PRs.
+  source_file_dependencies:
+    - vllm/distributed/kv_transfer/kv_connector/v1/nixl/
+    - tests/v1/kv_connector/nixl_integration/
+    - tests/v1/kv_connector/nixl_push_integration/
+  commands:
+    - bash /vllm-workspace/.buildkite/scripts/install-kv-connectors.sh
+    - bash v1/kv_connector/nixl_integration/config_sweep_accuracy_core_test.sh
+
 - label: ":nvidia: (L4) NixlConnector PD edge case"
   key: nixlconnector-pd-edge-cases-2-gpus
   timeout_in_minutes: 40

@@ -0,0 +1,74 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+set -euo pipefail
+
+# Core PD-disagg sweep sized for a 2-GPU pod so it can run on every PR; the
+# full 4-GPU sweeps (TP2/TP2, FlashInfer, the wider DP-EP and SW sets,
+# cross-layer, Mamba1) run nightly only (see .buildkite/test_areas/
+# disaggregated.yaml). run_accuracy_test.sh spreads engines over the visible
+# GPUs, so with 2 GPUs every TP>1 config co-locates prefill and decode ranks
+# on the same GPUs. Shared configs cap GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION at 0.4 so two
+# engines fit side by side; the TP1/TP1 configs keep one dedicated GPU per
+# side at the utilization the nightly sweep uses for the same model.
+SCRIPT="v1/kv_connector/nixl_integration/run_accuracy_test.sh"
+IMPORT_CANARY="v1/kv_connector/nixl_integration/test_nixl_imports.py"
+
+echo "=== Running NIXL import canary ==="
+python3 -m pytest -s -x "${IMPORT_CANARY}"
+
+# TP shapes and modes on the dense default model (Qwen3-0.6B). TP1/TP1 gets
+# one dedicated GPU per side. The hetero-TP configs (P TP1/D TP2 and
+# P TP2/D TP1) share one GPU between the prefiller and one decoder rank
+# (0.35 each), as does push-mode PP prefill (P TP1xPP2, D TP2, sharing both
+# GPUs). DP-attention decode runs the nightly sweep's MoE model
+# (deepseek-vl2-tiny, ~6.5 GB bf16): P TP1 and one D DP2 rank share GPU0, so
+# it needs 0.4 per engine to keep room for KV and CUDA contexts.
+dense_configs=(
+  "GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION=0.6 PREFILLER_TP_SIZE=1 DECODER_TP_SIZE=1"
+  "GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION=0.35 PREFILLER_TP_SIZE=1 DECODER_TP_SIZE=2"
+  "GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION=0.35 PREFILLER_TP_SIZE=2 DECODER_TP_SIZE=1"
+  "DP_EP=1 GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION=0.4 PREFILLER_TP_SIZE=1 DECODER_TP_SIZE=2 MODEL_NAMES=deepseek-ai/deepseek-vl2-tiny"
+  "KV_CONNECTOR=NixlPushConnector GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION=0.35 PREFILLER_PP_SIZE=2 PREFILLER_TP_SIZE=1 DECODER_TP_SIZE=2"
+)
+
+# Engine modes on the dense default model, TP1/TP1 on dedicated GPUs: the
+# sleep/wake round-trip, previously nightly only.
+mode_configs=(
+  "SLEEP_WAKE=1 GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION=0.6 PREFILLER_TP_SIZE=1 DECODER_TP_SIZE=1"
+)
+
+# Architecture coverage at TP1/TP1 on dedicated GPUs: MLA, hybrid SSM
+# conv-state transfer (Mamba2 and GDN), and sliding-window attention
+# combined with cross-layer KV sharing (gemma-4-E2B-it declares
+# num_kv_shared_layers in its HF config). Configs mirror the nightly
+# sweeps; the gemma config was previously unreachable, as no CI step
+# selects SW_ATTN.
+arch_configs=(
+  "GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION=0.8 MODEL_NAMES=deepseek-ai/deepseek-vl2-tiny"
+  "VLLM_SSM_CONV_STATE_LAYOUT=DS GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION=0.8 MODEL_NAMES=ibm-granite/granite-4.0-h-tiny VLLM_SERVE_EXTRA_ARGS=--max-model-len,8192,--trust-remote-code"
+  "VLLM_SSM_CONV_STATE_LAYOUT=DS GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION=0.8 MODEL_NAMES=Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B"
+  "GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION=0.8 MODEL_NAMES=google/gemma-4-E2B-it VLLM_SERVE_EXTRA_ARGS=--max-model-len,8192"
+)
+
+run_tests() {
+  local label=$1
+  local extra_args=$2
+
+  echo "=== Running tests (${label}) ==="
+  for cfg in "${configs[@]}"; do
+    local -a cfg_parts extra_args_parts
+    read -r -a cfg_parts <<< "$cfg"
+    read -r -a extra_args_parts <<< "$extra_args"
+
+    echo "-> Running with ${cfg} ${extra_args:+and ${extra_args}}"
+    # Use 'env' to safely set variables without eval
+    # keep argv splitting safe and SC2086-clean via arrays.
+    if ! env "${cfg_parts[@]}" bash "${SCRIPT}" "${extra_args_parts[@]}"; then
+      echo "❌ Test failed for config: ${cfg} ${extra_args:+(${extra_args})}"
+      exit 1
+    fi
+  done
+  echo "✅ All ${label} tests passed!"
+}
+
+configs=("${dense_configs[@]}" "${mode_configs[@]}" "${arch_configs[@]}")
+run_tests "default backend" ""
